name: 60613 · Chicago, IL
findings: ZIP 60613 (Chicago) has 232 nonprofit organizations. 111 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 93 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60613 (Chicago) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
26% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Housing organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 15 housing organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do housing organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 60613 (Chicago) list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 61% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to take civic or political action now, including outside formal organizations?
